frase_gancho.texto: A multiethnic mosaic where communal work, festivity and color honor life.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Step into the colossal ethnographic richness of the state of Oaxaca, a land where more than sixteen ethnic groups live side by side, including the Zapotec, Mixtec, Mixe, Chinantec and Mazatec. This extensive gallery reveals the vitality of community organization through communal work and traditional systems of service posts. Along the way, visitors will appreciate the extraordinary variety of embroidered traditional blouses, the black clay pottery of Coyotepec and the ritual attire of the religious stewardships. The narrative emphasizes how social reciprocity, devotion to sacred mountains and streams, and festive celebration strengthen cultural continuity.
